name: What information should I gather before my initial custom cabinetry consultation?
description: Before your consultation, gather kitchen dimensions, photos, inspiration images, and consider your functional and storage needs.

mainEntity.name: What information should I gather before my initial custom cabinetry consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your initial custom cabinetry consultation, it's beneficial to gather several pieces of information. This includes your kitchen's dimensions, photos of your existing kitchen, and any inspiration images or style preferences you have (e.g., modern, traditional, farmhouse). Thinking about your functional needs, such as specific storage requirements, appliance locations, and how you use your kitchen daily, will also be very helpful. Having these details prepared allows our design team to better understand your vision and provide more accurate recommendations and preliminary designs during your first meeting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before your consultation, gather kitchen dimensions, photos, inspiration images, and consider your functional and storage needs.
